text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Unity Cup is split between the preseason and the finals. Our first order of business will be to place high in the preseason races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Moreover, the Unity Cup is a team-based competition—in order to compete at all, I'll need to form a team.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I can get Umamusume interested in joining my team by reaching out to racers who have supported me or by doing well in the preseason matches.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'll also need to think up a team name. Thanks to Tazuna's encouragement, I feel fired up and more than ready to take on the challenge ahead!
